_comment: Source of truth for scripts/audit_make_targets.py (BITB-220). Every Makefile target must appear in `targets`. `safety` is the blast radius; `execution` is how the recipe was exercised during the audit: mocked = run for real by scripts/test_make_targets.py against recording fakes (az/docker/kubectl/terraform/gradle/...); static = dry-run (make -n) only, with blocked_reason. `tests` lists the covering ClassName.test_method entries (checked to exist). Regenerate docs/MAKE_TARGET_AUDIT.md with `python3 scripts/audit_make_targets.py --write`.

defects.summary: Firewall targets used the retired flag grammar (--name for the server, --rule-name for the rule). azure-cli 2.89 `az postgres flexible-server firewall-rule` expects --server-name/-s for the server and --name/-n for the rule; there is no --rule-name, so every call errored out.

Both pytest invocations ended in `|| true`, so a red api or migration suite still printed success and `make test` / `make check-all` reported green over failing tests. The pytest lines now fail the target (ruff/black/mypy stay advisory).

`$(SCRIPT_PYTHON) ... > opencode.json` truncated the committed artifact before the generator ran, so any generator failure left opencode.json empty. It now writes a temp file and renames into place (trap-cleaned).
`detect-secrets scan --update` was removed in detect-secrets >= 1.0; the target errored. `scan --baseline .secrets.baseline` is the in-place update.

`./gradlew testDebugCompose` is not a Gradle task, so the target errored. Fixed to `:app:testDebugUnitTest -PcomposeTestsOnly --tests "*ComposeTest"`, exactly as .github/workflows/android-compose-tests.yml runs it. AGENTS.md, opencode.json, .opencode/agents/verifier.md and android/COMPOSE_TESTS.md were corrected to match.
Removed `getinspired-dev_postgres_data` (a volume that never existed); the dev compose file declares `postgres_data_dev`, so the real volume name is `getinspired-dev_postgres_data_dev`.
The volume name was hardcoded, so a worktree or renamed clone `reset` a volume that did not exist. It now derives the Compose project name (COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME or the sanitised checkout directory).
A stray 'Full cleanup complete' success line (the clean-all message) was stranded at the end of fix-permissions.
A bare `sudo rm` blocked on a password prompt. Fixed to `sudo -n rm ... || rm ...` so it fails fast and the unprivileged rm takes over.

`az ... 2>/dev/null | head` / `az ... | xargs` returned the pipeline's (head/xargs) status, so a failed az (logged out, wrong subscription) printed nothing and exited 0. Output is now captured into a variable so a failed az fails the target and its stderr stays visible.

`$(CURDIR)/$(PYTHON)` turned an absolute VENV override (VENV=/opt/shared-venv) into `<cwd>//opt/shared-venv/bin/python`. PYTHON now comes from `$(abspath $(VENV))`, so absolute and relative overrides both resolve correctly.

Regression guard: the help scraping and the audit's help matcher must list every target described with a `##` comment, including names with digits (test-e2e) or multiple hyphens (collect-k8s-diagnostics).

The localhost check compared the raw grep|cut value of NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL without stripping surrounding quotes. The build targets need the value quoted (so `source` can carry the space-containing prod URL), so a quoted `http://localhost` value spuriously tripped the 'frontend will bypass your local API' warning. It now strips a leading/trailing quote before matching.

With the `|| true` removed (D2), `make test-backend` now fails fast when no PostgreSQL is reachable, because the api suite needs a real DB at collection time. CI supplies a pgvector service; locally the target needs DATABASE_URL pointed at a real DB.
defects.why: Correct fail-closed behaviour. Standing up a DB (or mocking collection) is out of scope for this audit; the DATABASE_URL default only exists so Settings() does not reject at import.

defects.summary: Both run `detect-secrets scan --baseline .secrets.baseline`, which rewrites the baseline in place, so a plain `make security` can leave an unintended working-tree diff.
defects.why: Matches the documented baseline-refresh workflow and the pre-commit hook; a read-only audit mode would need a detect-secrets feature change. Flagged for a follow-up story, not changed here.

defects.summary: db-upgrade runs `alembic upgrade head` against whatever $DATABASE_URL points to, with no host allowlist (unlike alembic-roundtrip, which refuses non-local hosts). Upgrade-only, so low risk, but it can mutate a production schema if misconfigured.
defects.why: Upgrade-only migrations are the intended production path (BITB-090). Adding a host guard mirroring alembic-roundtrip is a reasonable follow-up but changes operational behaviour, so it is documented rather than forced here.

help.note: Default goal; prints the command list, runs nothing else.

venv.blocked_reason: Creates a real Python virtualenv (python3 -m venv); exercised only indirectly as an install-deps prerequisite where a pre-seeded fake venv already exists, so no behaviour is asserted.

install-hooks.note: pip-installs pre-commit then registers the pre-commit and commit-msg hooks.

setup-dev.blocked_reason: Installs Python (requirements-dev + tools) and Node dependencies via `npm install` against live package indexes; never run in the offline sandbox.

lint.note: ruff + black --check (api) and npm run lint (frontend); read-only checks.

format.note: Rewrites source: black, isort, ruff --fix, prettier --write.

security.note: bandit/safety/npm-audit (read) plus detect-secrets scan --baseline, which can rewrite .secrets.baseline (open finding O2).

install-deps.note: Installs deps only when the `import pytest, alembic` sentinel fails.

test-backend.note: Runs the api + migration pytest suites; now fails fast without a DB (open finding O1).

test-frontend.note: npm run lint, tsc --noEmit, npm run build (build writes frontend/.next).

test.blocked_reason: Aggregate of test-backend + test-frontend with no recipe of its own; the two components are executed individually. Dry-run / up-to-date behaviour is pinned by MakePlumbingTests.test_files_named_like_targets_do_not_make_them_up_to_date.

test-makefile.blocked_reason: Self-referential: runs scripts.test_make_targets + `audit_make_targets.py --check`. It is the audit entry point, not re-entered inside its own sandbox.

alembic-roundtrip.note: upgrade->check->downgrade base->upgrade; drops every Alembic table. Refuses non-local hosts unless ALEMBIC_TEST_ALLOW_HOST=1.

db-upgrade.note: alembic upgrade head + current; upgrade-only but follows $DATABASE_URL (open finding O3).

android-security-check.note: gradle dependency dump + OWASP dependency-check CLI (downloads the NVD feed) --failOnCVSS 7.

test-e2e.note: pytest tests/e2e -m e2e against the production frontend URL default.

follow-up-eval.note: scripts/run_follow_up_eval.py against a live backend; ARGS passed through verbatim.

follow-up-checklist.note: Prints the offline on-device follow-up checklist.

golden-test.note: pytest tests/test_golden_set.py -m golden_set (mock mode; dummy DATABASE_URL never connected).

golden-live.note: scripts/run_golden_set.py against a running API; BASE_URL/CATEGORY quoted as single args.

check-all.note: lint + type-check + security + test + validate-env; fails if any component fails.

pre-commit.note: pre-commit run --all-files (hooks may rewrite files); needs only the pre-commit binary, not install-deps.

verify-opencode-config.note: Runs as the sync-opencode-configmap prerequisite: validates JSON, asserts 12 agents and fallback_models/plugin presence.

sync-opencode-configmap.note: kubectl create configmap --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f - (writes the live cluster ConfigMap).

test-kubeopencode-netpol.blocked_reason: Runs `pytest scripts/test_kubeopencode_netpol.py -q`; the sandbox pytest is a fake, so executing it asserts nothing. Command line pinned by MiscTargetTests.test_pytest_static_check_targets_run_their_suite (make -n).

test-cluster-triage.blocked_reason: Runs `pytest scripts/test_cluster_triage.py -q`; fake pytest asserts nothing. Command line pinned by MiscTargetTests.test_pytest_static_check_targets_run_their_suite (make -n).

collect-k8s-diagnostics.note: bash scripts/collect-k8s-diagnostics.sh; NAMESPACE/POD_IP passed as single args.

test-dns-watchdog.blocked_reason: Runs `pytest scripts/test_dns_watchdog.py -q`; fake pytest asserts nothing. SCRIPT_PYTHON selection pinned by ScriptPythonTests.test_script_python_prefers_venv_and_falls_back_to_python3 (make -n).

deploy-dns-watchdog.note: kubectl apply of the five dns-watchdog manifests to the live cluster.

lint-kubeopencode-dev-image.note: docker run hadolint on the dev-image Dockerfile.

build-kubeopencode-dev-image.note: docker build of the dev-toolchain image; TAG passed as a single arg.

validate-env.note: Run as a check-all prerequisite (scripts/validate-env.py; compares compose vs Terraform env vars).

clean.note: Removes caches, frontend/.next and frontend/node_modules via `sudo -n rm || rm` (D9).

clean-all.note: clean + removes the venv; prints the completion line exactly once.

fix-permissions.note: sudo chown of frontend/node_modules and frontend/.next (D8).

update-baseline.note: detect-secrets scan --baseline .secrets.baseline (D4; rewrites the baseline, open finding O2).

.env.local.note: File rule: copies .env.local.example once if .env.local is missing (not phony).

.env.dev.note: File rule: copies .env.dev.example; created as a docker-up-dev prerequisite (not phony).

check-env-production.note: Guard prerequisite: fails if .env.production is missing.

check-local-api-url.note: Guard prerequisite: warns when NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL is not localhost; strips surrounding quotes first (D13).

docker-up-gpu.note: Local stack with the GPU compose overlay.

docker-up-local-prod.note: Local containers wired to the PROD DB + cloud LLMs.

docker-up-local-prod-acr-be.note: ACR backend image + local frontend; TAG forwarded in the environment.

docker-up-dev.note: Dev stack on shifted ports; creates the shared ollama_data volume if absent.

docker-logs-dev-init.note: Tails the dev db-init container logs.

docker-test.note: Builds api/frontend then runs pytest in a throwaway api container.

functional-test.note: curl health + docker compose exec psql checks; degrades to exit 0 when services are down.

docker-build-prod.blocked_reason: Aggregate of docker-build-prod-backend + docker-build-prod-frontend; both push to ACR and are exercised individually.

docker-build-prod-backend.note: az acr login + docker build + docker push (bible-backend).

docker-build-prod-frontend.note: Stages CHANGELOG.md, builds with NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL as one arg, pushes, then docker-verify-frontend; CHANGELOG unstaged even on failure.

docker-verify-frontend.note: docker run grep over the built image; fails if localhost:8000 was baked in.

docker-update-tfvars.note: sed the git-SHA image tags into deployment/terraform.tfvars.

docker-deploy-prod-quick.note: az containerapp update for backend + frontend (no Terraform).

docker-build-deploy-prod.blocked_reason: Aggregate of docker-build-prod + docker-deploy-prod; both legs are exercised individually.

docker-get-backend-url.note: az containerapp show -> ingress fqdn; fails if az fails or fqdn is empty (D10).

update-env-backend-url.blocked_reason: Runs scripts/update-env-backend-url.sh, which queries Azure and rewrites .env.production. Command line pinned by MiscTargetTests.test_update_env_backend_url_runs_the_helper (make -n).

az-acr-list-images.note: az acr repository show-tags --detail per repo; fails when az fails (D10).

az-acr-list-tags.note: Quick tag list per repo; fails when az fails (D10).

az-deployed-images.note: Resolves the deployed image digest per container app; fails on az error (D10).

az-image-info.note: az acr repository show-tags for REPO/TAG; usage error without both.

db-backup.note: db-backup-restore.sh dump (reads the server, writes a local dump).

db-restore-local.note: Restores a dump into a local pgvector container.

db-restore-new-server.note: Azure PITR into a NEW server.

db-restore-same-server.note: DESTRUCTIVE: replaces an existing database from a dump.

db-server-url.note: Prints the DATABASE_URL for an Azure server; SERVER forwarded.

db-rehearse-alembic.note: stamp->check->upgrade against a COPY of prod (BITB-089).

db-delete-server.note: DESTRUCTIVE: deletes a restored Azure server; SERVER forwarded.

az-pg-add-ip.note: Adds the caller IP to the PG firewall (--server-name/--name, D1); aborts if the IP lookup fails.

az-pg-list-rules.note: Lists PG firewall rules; SERVER is a single argument.

az-pg-remove-ip.note: Deletes a firewall rule by RULE (required); --name is the rule (D1).

tf-check-version.note: Compares local terraform version to the pipeline; warns, never fails.

tf-init.note: terraform init; prefers backend.hcl, else detects the tfstate storage account via az.

tf-plan.note: terraform plan with both var files; requires the secrets file.

tf-apply.note: terraform apply (interactive) with both var files.

tf-destroy.note: terraform destroy; requires the secrets file.

tf-refresh.note: terraform refresh; rewrites state to match real infra.

repo-metrics.blocked_reason: Runs tools/repo-metrics analyze+render over git history and rewrites docs/metrics/. Interpreter (python3, not the venv) pinned by MiscTargetTests.test_metrics_targets_use_stdlib_python3 (make -n).

audit-metrics.blocked_reason: Runs tools/audit-metrics analyze+render and rewrites docs/audits/metrics/. Interpreter pinned by MiscTargetTests.test_metrics_targets_use_stdlib_python3 (make -n).
